html_source: Ian Gunn's map of the area around Lower Sackville (O'Connell) Street, showing locations of the offices of the Freeman's Journal and Evening Telegraph on Prince's Street (1), the Oval pub on Middle Abbey Street (2), Williams's Row (3), Dillon's auction house on Bachelor's Walk (4), and Mooney's pub on Lower Abbey Street (5), as well as the General Post Office and Nelson's pillar at top. Source: Gunn and Hart, James Joyce's Dublin.
